poc_metrics: With KV cache enabled: 68ms p95 @ same load, cache hit-rate 42% (sample traces)
With batching 8 and quantized int8 (AWQ): 42ms p95, median 9ms, throughput up ~2.8x vs baseline
Cost projection: hosted unquantized $18k/mo estimate -> quantized + batching $6.8k/mo estimate for same workload
Fallback test: switching to smaller model variant adds 12ms to cold-switch start but steady-state throughput holds
technical_requirements_summary: Latency SLO: p95 < 50ms for chat front-end 90% of day; burst tolerance to 2k RPS
Throughput: sustained ingest and rerank pipeline 1.5-2k RPS with tail under 150ms
Batching: need dynamic batching suggestions and safety knobs; want Redwood Optimize recommendations
Caching: KV/prefix caching mandatory for session histories > 512 tokens
Quantization: validated int8/AWQ profiles for selected models; fallback to fp16 when quality regressions detected
Observability: token-level latency, route-level cost, and per-model quality regression alerts tied to prompt sets
Network: VPC peering, egress rules, and optional air-gapped ingestion for certain telemetry pipelines
